name: buzzer-smd-label
title: Magnetic buzzer, surface mount, masking label
summary: As buzzer-smd, with the polyimide (Kapton) masking label over the top, cut round the sound port.
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); dimensions from CUI Devices' public CMI-9653S-SMT-TR datasheet (12/15/2022, p. 2; https://www.cuidevices.com, downloaded 18 November 2026); the label's size and thickness estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
